text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ――A medieval philosopher once said:

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"'Do not be led astray by the voices around you.
March forward without feeling empathy for an "idol,"' she said."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You're saying... I shouldn't empathize with an idol?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san,
about the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the girl who won the NHK Mile Cup
can't run after all.
Due to the gate limit...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. But do not let yourself be swayed.
Regardless of who enters or does not enter—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) is me!
The villain is also me! The director is me too!
And barely Doto!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...That's just how it is.
There's always next year for her.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Keep your mind undisturbed by anything and simply tread the path of supremacy!
Otherwise, you can never claim the throne in the Twinkle Series!

—That certain Umamusume cannot participate.
That news had reached Agnes Digital as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In the end... it turned out like this, huh...
She worked so hard in the Kobe Shimbun Hai back in September, too...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I couldn't reach it...
Even though I gave it everything I had..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It hurts... The most painful
since my debut...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Before I started running myself, it was never like this.
I could just innocently cheer her on, but now..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A paradise of Umamusume-chans...
I could have dreamed forever...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The tears of angels are packed beneath the sand.
Without even knowing that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And now, I've reached a place where I can't shine
without taking away someone else's chance to run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A total and complete dead end!
To think I have to head into the "Tenno Sho (Autumn)" feeling like this...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If only I had never debuted!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If I had just stayed my half-baked self, unable to choose between turf or dirt...! None of this...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Were they all things better left unknown?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's... not true at all.
Because...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What Umamusume-chan grabs hold of after enduring hardship!
Because I know just how overwhelmingly blinding and brilliant it is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Victory and defeat...
They linger over every race.
If there is a girl who wins, there is also a girl who loses...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's no way to prevent someone
from feeling sad. But—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even that frustration will become fuel for tomorrow!
Because I know that now! I've felt it with my own body!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can say it from the bottom of my heart! I can stan them!
The Umamusume of the Twinkle Series
are truly magnificent...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "No matter the adversity, with an indomitable SPARKLE, I'll blow it all awaaaayyyyy!!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
One day, absolutely!
Both me and her, we definitely will...!

After screaming at the top of her lungs...
Agnes Digital finally came to her senses.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can definitely... blow it away... What happened this time
had nothing to do with winning or losing, but still...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
One of the sorrows that can be overcome?
If Umamusume are indeed sacred beings, then...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Can she overcome this too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Will I be able to look back on this someday
and think of it as a trial meant for my growth?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so...
If she can overcome it that way...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
An all-rounder... As someone who can run
and conquer any track, I can't afford
to stumble here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The courage I swore to show her!
The spirit I inherited from King-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I have to show it.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Here I go, to the "Tenno Sho (Autumn)"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And if we're going, just going isn't enough.
That simply won't do!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's give them a clean, decisive victory
so she won't have any regrets about missing out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand on that stage next year. And to do that,
I'll deliver a run that makes me want to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna do it! Absolutely, positively, no matter what!
That is—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Running in races—that's my responsibility!

Agnes Digital steeled her resolve. Even so,
the formidable duo of TM Opera O and Meisho Doto
stands in her way, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A medieval philosopher... once said...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"'Do not be led astray by your surroundings,' she said.
'Keep walking forward without empathizing with those around you.'"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I empathize, I sympathize, and I weep!!!
As if it were happening to me personally!!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because that's who Agnes Digital is!!
Because I love Uma Musume so much!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To all the girls who tasted defeat!
I won't let your feelings go to waste!!
And so—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—I'll carry it all forward into my future races.
And turn it into my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This might still not be enough, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll throw everything at them! At the Overlord and Dotou-san!
The feelings of every single Umamusume I've ever met!

Love for Umamusume is power itself.
The immense sorrow she bore just before the race became Agnes Digital's greatest trump card.

With this fighting spirit, let's keep chasing
the backs of the top two right up until race day.
